description: This file defines the MessageOnlyLogFilter class, which implements the LogNode interface. It acts as a filter in a logging chain to pass only message content, omitting metadata such as tags, priorities, and exceptions. The class allows chaining with a subsequent LogNode.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A log filter class that suppresses all log data except the message text, useful for simplified log outputs.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the filter with an optional next LogNode.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Processes a log entry by passing only the message part to the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain where filtered logs are forwarded.
